acceptance: Each of the four queries has a stated cause with evidence
Q15, Q34, Q38 and Q87 match on the expression family at SF=0.1 after the fix, or are reclassified with evidence
pandas results for these queries are unchanged
context: Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T10). Hypothesis only. D4 (NULL-order policy) is recorded in dfparity-t00-owner-decisions: NULL order is fixed in implementations, not absorbed by the comparator. Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.
description: Hypothesis from a prior review (not verified by me): Q15 and Q34 on the expression family put NULLs first at position 0, and Q38/Q87 (EXCEPT/INTERSECT) differ because a Polars join treats NULL keys as unequal while SQL set operations treat them as equal (pandas merge matches NaN keys and Q38/Q87 pass on pandas). Reproduce, then fix at the cause with NULL-safe set operations and explicit NULL ordering. If a case is actually parameter drift or a tie, reclassify it.
